observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — v1 cerrada; v2 = VLM
observations.content:
**What**: v1 freeze del pipeline PP-OCRv6 medium + rescate angular. No más Hough/tuneo fino de diagonales como camino principal. v2 usará VLM.
**Why**: Techo del OCR clásico en nubes/diagonales; usuario cerró v1 explícitamente.
**Where**: docs/PRODUCT.md, CHANGELOG.md, README.md. Repo: https://github.com/javi2481/idp-ocr-studio.git main.
**Learned**: Smoke v1: poster TRY/WERE ±90; nubes confAvg ~0.94/0.89 y más orientation≠0. Detección = familia DB vía PP-OCRv6_*_det.

observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — overview post-higiene
observations.content:
Academic low-code MVP v1: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind frontend; FastAPI + PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6.
Repo: https://github.com/javi2481/idp-ocr-studio.git
Philosophy: orquestar API oficial PaddleOCR 3.x (no inventar motores); sin Docker/DB/colas/auth.
Structure: backend/app/ (ocr, orientation, parsing, routes, schemas, storage) + shim backend/main.py; frontend/src/{components,hooks,lib,types}; docs/; tests/fixtures/images/; scripts/dev.ps1|sh.
Tier medium fijo. Rescue: minAreaRect + sweep ±7.5/15, margen diagonal 0.02. Export JSON/MD/CSV/TXT + PNG anotado.
Formats: PNG JPG WEBP GIF BMP TIFF ICO PPM AVIF. PDF NO.
Run: ./scripts/dev.sh → API :8100 UI :5173.
Smoke: tests/fixtures/images/poster.avif → TRY=-90 WERE=+90.
v1 CERRADA; v2 = VLM. Ver docs/PRODUCT.md y CHANGELOG.md.

observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — continue on Linux PC
observations.content:
git clone https://github.com/javi2481/idp-ocr-studio.git
cd idp-ocr-studio && git pull
# HEAD v1 freeze: main (incl. App slim + rescue diagonal + docs v1/v2)
engram import engram-export.json   # solo memorias idp-ocr-studio
cd backend && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cd ../frontend && npm install
cd .. && ./scripts/dev.sh

Fixtures: tests/fixtures/images/
API :8100, UI :5173. Warmup Paddle en primer arranque.
v1 cerrada; no seguir Hough. v2 = VLM.

observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — rescue angular + medium fijo
observations.content:
**What**: _estimate_text_angle (minAreaRect) + SWEEP_DELTAS ±7.5/15; margen 0.02 diagonales; Region.orientation float; UI tier medium fijo.
**Why**: Nubes/diagonales fallaban con solo 0/180 de textline orientation.
**Where**: backend/app/orientation.py, backend/app/ocr.py, frontend hooks/components.
**Learned**: E2E poster TRY/WERE ±90; nubes mejoraron orientation≠0. Techo clásico → v2 VLM.

observations.title: Cotejo PaddleOCR implementado P0-P2
observations.content:
**What**: Backlog cotejo: .env.example, UI text_det_*, warmup lifespan, /health device, /export/{id}/annotated save_to_img, Run All via inferBatch.
**Why**: Alinear con PaddleOCR 3.x oficial; no inventar APIs (sin det_db_*/use_dilation).
**Where**: backend/app/*, frontend/src/*, README.md, docs/archive/.
